subject: Dedicated GPU pool review — scheduling & stakeholder itinerary
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@marblebank.com>, Sam Green <sam.green@infraworks.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Dedicated GPU pool review — scheduling & stakeholder itinerary

Hi Priya / Sam,

Thanks again for taking the time to evaluate Redwood for your reserved-capacity needs. Per our discovery last week, the most useful next step is a focused architecture working session to align on pool sizing assumptions, autoscaling policies, and tenant isolation patterns.

High-level objective: Agree on an initial pool topology and autoscale guardrails so your infra team can size procurement and we can prepare a targeted POC.

Suggested duration: 90 minutes (60-minute architecture + 30-minute ops breakout)
Proposed dates/times (PST):
  - Wed Nov 11: 10:00–11:30
  - Thu Nov 12: 08:30–10:00
  - Fri Nov 13: 13:00–14:30

Proposed agenda (draft):
  1) Quick context & objectives (5m)
  2) Traffic profile and SLO constraints — Marble Bank (10m)
  3) Pool sizing & headroom math — Redwood (20m)
  4) Autoscale design (policies, cooldowns, safety nets) (20m)
  5) Isolation modes & failover (10m)
  6) Ops breakout: deployment/runbook questions (30m)
  7) Action items & next steps (5m)

Pre-reads: attached 1-pager + pool-sizing worksheet. If you have a recent token/throughput profile we can pre-load it into the sheet.

Attachments: redwood_dedicated_review_v1.pdf (PDF, 3 MB); pool-sizing-sheet.xlsx (Excel, 130 KB)

Please let me know which slot works and who from your side should join the ops breakout (security, SRE, procurement). Happy to adjust timing for Europe-friendly windows if needed.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.ai | +1 415 555 0192
From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@marblebank.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Sam Green <sam.green@infraworks.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Dedicated GPU pool review — scheduling & stakeholder itinerary

Thanks Aditya — appreciate the clear agenda.

Quick heads up: I have a board prep conflict on Wed 11/11 in the morning and will be traveling that day. Thu 11/12 works better for our team, but we need to push the start to 09:30 EST (which is 06:30 PST) or do 13:00 EST (10:00 PST).

Attendees from Marble Bank we want on the call:
  - Priya Shah (platform lead) — me
  - Ben Wallace (SRE) — ben.wallace@marblebank.com
  - Leila Ortiz (security) — leila.ortiz@marblebank.com (needs to attend the isolation + data separation discussion)

Also, could you add an ops-runbook draft so our SRE can review ahead of time? Sam — can you confirm you'll join the ops breakout as well?

Thanks,
Priya
VP, Platform Engineering
Marble Bank
priya.shah@marblebank.com | +1 212 555 4582

Hi Priya — happy to accommodate the Thu timing. 13:00 EST / 10:00 PST (Thu 11/12) works on our side.

Couple quick notes:
  - We'll split the session: 60m architecture + 30m ops breakout. Ops breakout will have Karthik (infrastructure lead) and me. If Leila wants to go deep on isolation and encryption-at-rest patterns we can reserve an extra 15 minutes at the end of the ops slot.
  - I attached a draft runbook that captures deployment steps, alerting thresholds, and rollback guidance — Ben can scan the SRE checklist and call out any missing items.
  - Sam, can you come with a short list of integration risks you've seen from infra partners? 5–7m is enough.

I've updated the pool-sizing-sheet with two sample workloads (low-latency chat, batch embeddings) and a conservative headroom multiplier. Please review and drop your throughput numbers in the 'Customer inputs' tab: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b_example_drive_link

I'll send a calendar invite with the finalized invite and the ops breakout as a separate 30-min event.

Attachments: ops-runbook-draft.docx (Word, 210 KB)

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 415 555 0219

Confirmed for Thu 11/12 at 10:00 PST / 13:00 EST. Calendar invite sent: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abcd1234efgh

Pre-reads are the two attachments (deck + sheet) and the runbook I just uploaded. Quick ask for Marble Bank prior to the session:
  - A typical 1-hour token distribution or sample trace for your busiest endpoint (or estimated tokens/sec)
  - Any hard latency SLOs (p50/p90/p99) for inference paths you care about

During the architecture section we'll run a short capacity model that translates tokens/sec into GPU slots and discuss quantization/embedding tradeoffs. In the ops breakout we'll walk the runbook and mark owner assignments.

If Leila would like to extend the isolation conversation we can bump the ops slot by 15m, but I wanted to keep the first invite to 90m to respect calendars.

Thanks all — see you Thursday.
Karthik Iyer
Infrastructure Lead, Redwood Inference
